about_the_game:
Arcanus Legends craft any spell imaginable and rebuild villages while facing epic challenges in a magical universe. Arcanus Legends is a single player & online co-op action RPG.

Dynamic Spell Crafting System: In Arcanus Legends, magic is not just a tool, but a canvas for players to unleash their creativity. With a robust spell crafting system, players can customize and create spells using various modifiers. These modifiers can be found through quests, challenges or exploring the dungeons.

Sandbox Village Building: Collect mystical runes to bring back the town's inhabitants and their homes from the timeless dimension. Witness the town evolve and thrive under your magical influence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred), HDD (Supported), 720p/30 fps, Low Quality Settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 (3.2Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or INTEL Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 85 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD, 1080p/60 fps, High Quality Settings
